Never assume they're safe, even at a relative's house. 🏠 Give your child a code word.

Clara is seven. Before every sleepover, her mom reminds her: "If you ever say 'purple pancakes,' I'll come and get you. No questions." 🥞 Because:
✅ Not everyone knows her boundaries, even family. A high five is fine instead of a kiss.
✅ She may be afraid to speak up and disappoint an adult.
✅ Family isn't automatically safe.
✅ Never force her to stay. "Stay! It'll be fun!"
✅ Know who will be there. 📞
✅ No secrets about her body. Surprises are fun to wait for. Secrets about her body are never okay. 🔒
✅ Never make her feel guilty for saying no. "No, thank you."

One night, something doesn't feel right. Clara's phone lights up her mom's screen: "Mom? Purple pancakes." 💜 Mom comes. No questions. No guilt. ❤️

Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me and do not hinder them." Matthew 19:14 (ESV) 🙏 Every child is always welcome to Him.

Kids can't trust everyone. But they need to know they can tell you anything. ❤️ And some worries are too big for a child to say out loud.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
